title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Migalastat in Patients with Fabry Disease
inclusion_criteria: Documented clinical diagnosis of Fabry disease (GLA mutation status confirmed).
Male or female aged 18 years or older.
Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) >= 30 mL/min/1.73 m2.
On stable enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) for at least 12 months prior to screening.
exclusion_criteria: History of kidney transplantation or currently receiving dialysis.
History of stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) within the last 6 months.
Known hypersensitivity or allergy to migalastat or its excipients.

title: A Phase 1/2 Study of Gene Therapy (FLT190) in Patients with Fabry Disease
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis of classic Fabry disease (GLA activity < 1% of normal).
exclusion_criteria: Presence of neutralizing antibodies to AAV2/6 capsid.
History of stroke, heart failure, or severe cardiac hypertrophy.
